title: Test principle ranking, the cap, the overflow line and the cap-time name check
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee principle && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test principle_index_parity

truths: a test shows a row whose signals match the lane or a touched file ranks above a row that matches nothing
a test shows a row with fewer classes ranks above a row with more classes when signals tie
a test shows at most principles_cap rows print and the rest appear as one overflow line, and that a class under the cap prints no overflow line
a test shows principles_cap from config changes the count and an invalid value falls back to 7
a test shows a cap refuses an unknown principle slug and an empty changed part, and records off_route true for a known slug outside the routed list
each new test was seen failing against a deliberately broken variant before it passed
key_links: tests assert behaviour through principle_lines and the cap verb, not private helpers
prohibitions: Do not change non-test code; report a defect instead
must_haves.why: A code cell never certifies itself; a separate tester pins pgg-3 behaviour.

action: You are the tester for pgg-3 and share no context with its author. Read docs/history/pstack-guide-gaps/CONTEXT.md D4 and D5 and the pgg-3 diff (git log -1 -p on the pgg-3 commit). Add tests in the tests module of src/principles.rs and in src/verbs/cells/tests.rs (and src/verbs/drivers/tests.rs for the worker arm passing the cell's files) that pin each must_have truth, through principle_lines and the cap verb as existing tests there do (see a_principles_arm_cap_needs_an_answer_and_a_holdout_arm_cap_does_not near tests.rs:6680 for the cap pattern). Name each test as a behaviour sentence and include the word principle in it so the verify filter selects it. For each new test, break the code it guards once (for example flip the rank order, or skip the slug check), watch it fail for that reason, and restore. If pgg-3 got a behaviour wrong, do not fix production code: report it as a finding. Allowed commands: cargo test with a filter, git. Never run the full suite, any bee dispatch verb or its help. No code comments. Proof: the verify command output with the count of new tests.
